value.rationale: Determines an intrinsic topological obstruction (nonzero reduced Euler characteristic) and exponential rational homology in every member of the canonical circular-ladder cubic family, including exact finite exceptional sign; the order-six characteristic factor and spectral gap give a structural all-size theorem beyond routine small enumeration or generic transfer existence.
